name: Oslo Airport, Gardermoen

runway.v: Runway 01L/19R 3600 m x 45 m; runway 01R/19L 2950 m x 45 m.

slots.v: All flights must have allocated arrival and departure times.
slots.quote: All flights operating at Oslo Airport, Gardermoen are subject to compulsory allocation of arrival and departure times.

max_aircraft.v: Aerodrome reference code 4E on all runways. Code F operations are described in AIP Norway ENGM AD 2.23, which could not be read.
max_aircraft.quote: The AD reference code is 4E for all runways.

handling.quote: Ground handling is compulsory at Oslo Airport.

noise.v: At night, reverse thrust beyond idle after landing is not permitted. The page does not give the night hours.
noise.quote: During the night period, reversing of jet engines beyond "idle reverse" after landing is not permitted.

fuel.v: Jet A1 and F34 24 hours. 100LL on request at set hours.

deicing.v: An agreement with a de-icing operator is required before engine start for departure.
deicing.quote: An agreement on ACFT de-icing must be established with a de-icing operator prior to engine start-up for departure.

curfew.v: Not a closure. Departures with certified take-off noise above 88 EPNdB are not allowed 24:00-06:30. Aircraft not meeting ICAO Annex 16 Chapter III may fly only 08:00-16:00. Check the aircraft's noise certificate. The report does not list exemptions and does not label the times; read as local, Norwegian-language report on local traffic
curfew.applies_to: departures with certified departure noise above 88 EPNdB
curfew.quote: Ifølge § 10 i forskriften tillates ikke avganger med sertifisert avgangsstøy over 88 EPNdB i tidsrommet mellom 24:00 og 06:30
